answer.sql:
WITH claim_loss_expense AS (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Loss_Payment_Amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Loss_Reserve_Amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Expense_Payment_Amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Expense_Reserve_Amount
    FROM claim_amount ca
    LEFT JOIN loss_payment lp ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN loss_reserve lr ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN expense_payment ep ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN expense_reserve er ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
policy_premium AS (
    SELECT pa.Policy_Identifier, SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Premium_Amount
    FROM policy_amount pa
    JOIN premium pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
),
policy_holder AS (
    SELECT
        apr.Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier,
        COALESCE(pe.First_Name || ' ' || pe.Last_Name, o.Organization_Name) AS Policy_Holder_Name
    FROM agreement_party_role apr
    JOIN party_role rc ON rc.Party_Role_Code = apr.Party_Role_Code
    LEFT JOIN person pe ON pe.Person_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN organizations o ON o.Organization_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
    WHERE rc.Party_Role_Name ILIKE '%holder%'
),
policy_agent AS (
    SELECT
        apr.Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier,
        COALESCE(pe.First_Name || ' ' || pe.Last_Name, o.Organization_Name) AS Agent_Name
    FROM agreement_party_role apr
    JOIN party_role rc ON rc.Party_Role_Code = apr.Party_Role_Code
    LEFT JOIN person pe ON pe.Person_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN organizations o ON o.Organization_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
    WHERE rc.Party_Role_Name ILIKE '%agent%'
)
SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS Claim_Number,
    p.Policy_Number,
    ph.Policy_Holder_Name,
    pag.Agent_Name,
    pp.Premium_Amount,
    cle.Loss_Payment_Amount,
    cle.Loss_Reserve_Amount,
    cle.Expense_Payment_Amount,
    cle.Expense_Reserve_Amount
FROM claim c
JOIN claim_loss_expense cle ON cle.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN claim_coverage cc ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN policy_coverage_detail pcd ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_premium pp ON pp.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_holder ph ON ph.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_agent pag ON pag.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier;

SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    apr.Party_Identifier AS Agent_Identifier
FROM policy p
JOIN agreement_party_role apr
    ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN party_role pr
    ON pr.Party_Role_Code = apr.Party_Role_Code
WHERE pr.Party_Role_Name = 'Agent';

SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    AVG(DATE_DIFF('day', c.Claim_Open_Date, c.Claim_Close_Date)) AS avg_days_to_settle
FROM claim c
JOIN claim_coverage cc
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
JOIN policy_coverage_detail pcd
    ON cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN policy p
    ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
WHERE c.Claim_Close_Date IS NOT NULL
  AND c.Claim_Open_Date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number;

SELECT
    c.Claim_Identifier,
    c.Company_Claim_Number,
    SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS Total_Loss
FROM claim c
JOIN claim_amount ca ON c.Claim_Identifier = ca.Claim_Identifier
WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_payment)
   OR ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_reserve)
   OR ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM expense_payment)
   OR ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM expense_reserve)
GROUP BY c.Claim_Identifier, c.Company_Claim_Number;

  SELECT
    cc.Claim_Identifier,
    pcd.Policy_Identifier,
    SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_loss
  FROM claim_amount ca
  JOIN claim_coverage cc ON ca.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier

  GROUP BY cc.Claim_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier
)
SELECT
  p.Policy_Number,
  AVG(cl.total_loss) AS average_loss
FROM policy p
JOIN claim_loss cl ON p.Policy_Identifier = cl.Policy_Identifier
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number;

SELECT p.Policy_Number, pa.Policy_Amount

WITH claim_amounts AS (
  SELECT
    ca.Claim_Identifier,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS loss_payment_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS loss_reserve_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS expense_payment_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS expense_reserve_amount
  FROM claim_amount ca
  LEFT JOIN loss_payment lp ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN loss_reserve lr ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN expense_payment ep ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN expense_reserve er ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = er.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
policy_link AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    c.Claim_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Number
  FROM claim c
  JOIN claim_coverage cc ON c.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
  JOIN policy_coverage_detail pcd ON cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
  JOIN policy p ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
),
premium_amt AS (
  SELECT
    pa.Policy_Identifier,
    SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium_amount
  FROM policy_amount pa
  JOIN premium pr ON pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier
  GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
),
policy_holder AS (
  SELECT
    apr.Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier,
    COALESCE(per.First_Name || ' ' || per.Last_Name, org.Organization_Name) AS policy_holder_name
  FROM agreement_party_role apr
  JOIN party_role pr ON apr.Party_Role_Code = pr.Party_Role_Code
  JOIN party pty ON apr.Party_Identifier = pty.Party_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN person per ON pty.Party_Identifier = per.Person_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN organizations org ON pty.Party_Identifier = org.Organization_Identifier
  WHERE pr.Party_Role_Name LIKE '%Policy Holder%'
),
agent AS (
  SELECT
    apr.Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier,
    COALESCE(per.First_Name || ' ' || per.Last_Name, org.Organization_Name) AS agent_name
  FROM agreement_party_role apr
  JOIN party_role pr ON apr.Party_Role_Code = pr.Party_Role_Code
  JOIN party pty ON apr.Party_Identifier = pty.Party_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN person per ON pty.Party_Identifier = per.Person_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN organizations org ON pty.Party_Identifier = org.Organization_Identifier
  WHERE pr.Party_Role_Name LIKE '%Agent%'
)
SELECT
  c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
  pl.Policy_Number AS policy_number,
  ph.policy_holder_name AS policy_holder,
  prem.premium_amount,
  cat.Catastrophe_Name AS catastrophe,
  ag.agent_name AS agent,
  ca_agg.loss_payment_amount,
  ca_agg.loss_reserve_amount,
  ca_agg.expense_payment_amount,
  ca_agg.expense_reserve_amount
FROM claim c
LEFT JOIN claim_amounts ca_agg ON c.Claim_Identifier = ca_agg.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN catastrophe cat ON c.Catastrophe_Identifier = cat.Catastrophe_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_link pl ON c.Claim_Identifier = pl.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN premium_amt prem ON pl.Policy_Identifier = prem.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_holder ph ON pl.Policy_Identifier = ph.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN agent ag ON pl.Policy_Identifier = ag.Policy_Identifier;

    ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier

SELECT p.Policy_Number, COUNT(DISTINCT c.Claim_Identifier) AS Number_Of_Claims
FROM claim c
JOIN claim_coverage cc ON c.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
JOIN policy_coverage_detail pcd ON cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN policy p ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number;

SELECT
  p.Policy_Number,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cl.Claim_Identifier) AS number_of_claims,
  AVG(loss_per_claim.total_loss) AS average_loss
FROM policy p
JOIN policy_coverage_detail pcd
  ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN claim_coverage cc
  ON cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN claim cl
  ON cl.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
JOIN (
  SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_loss
  FROM claim_amount ca
  WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_payment)
     OR ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_reserve)
     OR ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM expense_payment)
     OR ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM expense_reserve)
  GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
) loss_per_claim
  ON loss_per_claim.Claim_Identifier = cl.Claim_Identifier
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number;

SELECT p.Policy_Number, SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Total_Premium_Amount
FROM policy p
JOIN policy_amount pa ON p.Policy_Identifier = pa.Policy_Identifier
JOIN premium pr ON pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number;

WITH claim_totals AS (
    SELECT
        cl.Claim_Identifier,
        cl.Company_Claim_Number,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_loss_payment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_loss_reserve,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense_payment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense_reserve
    FROM claim cl
    JOIN claim_amount ca ON ca.Claim_Identifier = cl.Claim_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN loss_payment lp ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN loss_reserve lr ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN expense_payment ep ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN expense_reserve er ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY cl.Claim_Identifier, cl.Company_Claim_Number
),
claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        cc.Claim_Identifier,
        pcd.Policy_Identifier
    FROM claim_coverage cc
    JOIN policy_coverage_detail pcd ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
policy_premium AS (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS total_premium
    FROM policy_amount pa
    JOIN premium pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
),
policy_holder AS (
    SELECT
        apr.Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier,
        p.Party_Identifier,
        COALESCE(pe.First_Name || ' ' || pe.Last_Name, o.Organization_Name) AS Policy_Holder_Name
    FROM agreement_party_role apr
    JOIN party_role prl ON prl.Party_Role_Code = apr.Party_Role_Code
    JOIN party p ON p.Party_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN person pe ON pe.Person_Identifier = p.Party_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN organizations o ON o.Organization_Identifier = p.Party_Identifier
    WHERE LOWER(REPLACE(prl.Party_Role_Name, ' ', '')) LIKE '%policyholder%'
)
SELECT
    ct.Company_Claim_Number AS Claim_Number,
    pol.Policy_Number,
    ph.Policy_Holder_Name,
    pp.total_premium AS Premium_Amount_Paid,
    (ct.total_loss_payment + ct.total_loss_reserve + ct.total_expense_payment + ct.total_expense_reserve) AS Total_Loss
FROM claim_totals ct
JOIN claim_policy cp ON cp.Claim_Identifier = ct.Claim_Identifier
JOIN policy pol ON pol.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_premium pp ON pp.Policy_Identifier = pol.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_holder ph ON ph.Policy_Identifier = pol.Policy_Identifier;

WITH loss_pay AS (
    SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS Loss_Payment_Amount
    FROM claim_amount ca
    JOIN loss_payment lp ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
loss_res AS (
    SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS Loss_Reserve_Amount
    FROM claim_amount ca
    JOIN loss_reserve lr ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
exp_pay AS (
    SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS Expense_Payment_Amount
    FROM claim_amount ca
    JOIN expense_payment ep ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
exp_res AS (
    SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS Expense_Reserve_Amount
    FROM claim_amount ca
    JOIN expense_reserve er ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cc.Claim_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier
    FROM claim_coverage cc
    JOIN policy_coverage_detail pcd
      ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
premium_amt AS (
    SELECT pa.Policy_Identifier, SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Premium_Amount_Paid
    FROM policy_amount pa
    JOIN premium p ON p.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
),
policy_holder AS (
    SELECT apr.Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier, pt.Party_Name AS Policy_Holder_Name
    FROM agreement_party_role apr
    JOIN party_role pr ON pr.Party_Role_Code = apr.Party_Role_Code
    JOIN party pt ON pt.Party_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
    WHERE pr.Party_Role_Name ILIKE '%holder%'
)
SELECT
    c.Claim_Identifier,
    c.Company_Claim_Number,
    pol.Policy_Number,
    ph.Policy_Holder_Name,
    COALESCE(lp.Loss_Payment_Amount, 0) AS Loss_Payment_Amount,
    COALESCE(lr.Loss_Reserve_Amount, 0) AS Loss_Reserve_Amount,
    COALESCE(ep.Expense_Payment_Amount, 0) AS Expense_Payment_Amount,
    COALESCE(er.Expense_Reserve_Amount, 0) AS Expense_Reserve_Amount,
    COALESCE(pr_amt.Premium_Amount_Paid, 0) AS Premium_Amount_Paid
FROM claim c
LEFT JOIN loss_pay lp ON lp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN loss_res lr ON lr.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN exp_pay ep ON ep.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN exp_res er ON er.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN claim_policy cp ON cp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy pol ON pol.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN premium_amt pr_amt ON pr_amt.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_holder ph ON ph.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier;

SELECT
    apr.Party_Identifier AS Agent_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Number,
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS Claim_Number,
    SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS Loss_Payment_Amount
FROM agreement_party_role apr
JOIN party_role pr
    ON apr.Party_Role_Code = pr.Party_Role_Code
JOIN policy p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = apr.Agreement_Identifier
JOIN policy_coverage_detail pcd
    ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN claim_coverage cc
    ON cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN claim c
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
JOIN claim_amount ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN loss_payment lp
    ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
WHERE pr.Party_Role_Name = 'Agent'
GROUP BY apr.Party_Identifier, p.Policy_Number, c.Company_Claim_Number;

SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_loss
FROM policy p
JOIN policy_coverage_detail pcd
    ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN claim_coverage cc
    ON cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN claim cl

   OR ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM expense_reserve)
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number;

WITH loss_total AS (
    SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_loss
    FROM claim_amount ca
    WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_payment
        UNION
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_reserve
        UNION
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM expense_payment
        UNION
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM expense_reserve
    )
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.Claim_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier
    FROM claim c
    JOIN claim_coverage cc ON c.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
    JOIN policy_coverage_detail pcd ON cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
policy_premium AS (
    SELECT pa.Policy_Identifier, SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium
    FROM policy_amount pa
    JOIN premium pr ON pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
)
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cp.Claim_Identifier) AS number_of_claims,
    SUM(lt.total_loss) AS total_loss,
    pp.premium AS premium,
    SUM(lt.total_loss) / pp.premium AS loss_ratio
FROM claim_policy cp
JOIN loss_total lt ON cp.Claim_Identifier = lt.Claim_Identifier
JOIN policy p ON cp.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN policy_premium pp ON p.Policy_Identifier = pp.Policy_Identifier
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number, pp.premium
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number;
